strategy_rules.conservative: Require Monte Carlo feasibility >= 0.95; maximize research-benefit p10; break ties by lower cost.
strategy_rules.balanced: Use the declared balanced post-optimization policy weights.
strategy_rules.research_first: Use the declared research-first post-optimization policy weights.
strategy_rules.innovation_first: Use the declared innovation-first weights and flag unsupported evidence.
strategy_rules.student_first: Use the declared student-first weights and flag unsupported evidence.
strategy_rules.compromise: Minimize normalized distance to the supported-objective ideal; a knee is unavailable when fewer than two supported objectives vary.
